name: Morph Invite
title: Morph Invite
description: An avatar invite pill that expands into an email field with coordinated GSAP spring motion.
summary: A compact team invitation control inspired by the reference video. The avatar stack compresses as the email field opens, submission shows pending and success states, and a new avatar settles into the stack before the pill closes. Includes async callbacks, retryable errors, duplicate checks, keyboard support, and reduced motion.
highlights: Coordinated pill expansion and avatar compression without scaling text
Adjustable stiffness, damping, mass, playback speed, and expanded width
Async invite callback with pending, success, and retryable failure states
New avatar entrance following a successful callback
Email validation, duplicate prevention, and abort signal on unmount
Responsive width, keyboard navigation, and reduced-motion support
anatomy: Overlapping initials avatars with animated spacing
Invite trigger and inline email form
Accessible error message and live status

physics.engine: GSAP timeline with a spring easing function
physics.description: Uses the existing Motion spring generator as easing for GSAP. Pill geometry, avatar spacing, and face crossfades share one interruptible timeline.

accessibility.aria: Labeled email input, aria-expanded trigger, inert hidden form, pending state, live status, and linked error message.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Skips geometry, avatar, and spinner motion when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

keyboard.description: Open the invite field from the trigger.
Close the field and return focus to the invite trigger.
Navigate between the email field and send button.

recommended: Team toolbars and collaborative project headers
bestPractices: Connect onInvite to your invitation service and resolve only after successful submission.
Use the provided AbortSignal to cancel work when the component unmounts.
Return a member from onInvite to customize the new avatar.
The showcase simulates submission locally; it sends no email.

props.name: members

props.type: (email: string, signal: AbortSignal) => void | MorphInviteMember | Promise<void | MorphInviteMember>
props.description: Invite handler. Resolve on success, optionally return the new member, or throw an error to allow retry.

props.description: Expanded pill width in pixels, constrained to its available container space.
